scripts.build:student: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode student && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('dist-site/student.html','dist-site/index.html')" && node scripts/pwa.mjs student dist-site
scripts.build:admin: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode admin && node scripts/pwa.mjs admin dist-site/admin
scripts.build:site: npm run build:student && npm run build:admin
